name: manual_79413f
claim: When two branches independently evolve 'the same' fix (e.g. two GossipBus atomic-transaction APIs), don't blindly port one branch's implementation onto the other — check the target branch's own established style first (e.g. PR206's BEGIN IMMEDIATE + bounded lock-retry vs PR205's simpler transaction()-only pattern) and match that, or you introduce an inconsistent API surface within one branch.

decisions.notes: PR205 and PR206 both needed the release-side half of an atomic claim/release fix. PR206 already had a more mature claim-side implementation (explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE write-lock + retry-on-busy) than PR205's simpler version. Built the release-side fix to match each branch's own existing style rather than copy-pasting PR205's version onto PR206, which would have left two inconsistent transaction patterns in the same file.
